permissions.name: computer-use.cua
permissions.description: Use the configured native CUA MCP driver.

notes: The plugin launches the configured Cua Driver MCP process directly with the standard, promptless driver permission mode.
DUYA MCP approval is the consent boundary for write tool calls; this policy declaration does not render a consent prompt by itself.

The plugin denies every desktop input unless the configured app policy allows the observed target, keeps revocation scoped to write tools, and writes a rotating JSONL audit trail with the call identity, target identity, result and policy conclusion.
